title: CUB K1 classification-protective gradient projection screen
research_question: With Random-K1 annotation masks fixed, can classification-protective projection of conflicting keypoint gradients reduce class-level negative transfer without sacrificing recognition benefit?

method.name: CLASSIFICATION_PROTECTIVE_PROJECTION
method.classification_objective: cross entropy on all fold-training images
method.auxiliary_objective: the unchanged sparse keypoint and complementary-attention loss from PAT-D-260728-004
method.shared_parameters: all trainable tensors reached by both objectives
method.rule: if the global dot product between classification and auxiliary gradients is negative, replace g_aux with g_aux - dot(g_aux,g_cls)/||g_cls||^2 * g_cls; otherwise retain g_aux

training.paired_baseline: stored PAT-D-260728-004 Naive Random-K1 predictions with identical selection masks and fold seeds

confirmation_gate.on_pass: freeze a CCT20+ Oracle and safety-method transfer protocol before decoding development images
confirmation_gate.on_no_pass: stop this gradient-safety mechanism and keep all final splits locked
